title: A Hadamard Formula for Equilibrium Envelopes under Parallel Deformation
summary: Let $(X,ω_0)$ be a compact Kähler manifold of complex dimension $n$, and let $U\Subset X$ have $C^{3,1}$ uniformly strongly pseudoconvex boundary.
